nutrition.title: Nutrition advice
nutrition.subtitle: Choose the right diet by pet type and age
nutrition.tip1: Feed 2-3 times a day at the same time
nutrition.tip3: Don't change food amount suddenly, switch gradually
nutrition.tip4: Table food is dangerous for most pets

foods.dogGood: Premium dry food, meat (cooked), vegetables, rice
foods.dogBad: Chocolate, onion, garlic, grapes, raisins, bird bones, dough
foods.catGood: Premium dry food, fish, cooked chicken, special wet food
foods.catBad: Chocolate, onion, garlic, milk (for many cats), dog food
foods.rabbitGood: Hay, fresh vegetables, special pellets, clean water
foods.birdGood: Seed mixes, fresh fruits and vegetables, cuttlebone
foods.hamsterGood: Special pellets, fresh vegetables, a little fruit
foods.hamsterBad: Sugar, citrus, onion, garlic, spicy food

about.title: About PetCare
about.text1: PetCare is a modern platform that helps pet owners. Our goal is to ensure every pet receives proper care, proper nutrition and timely medical help.
about.text2: Our team includes experienced veterinarians, zoologists and developers who love animals. All information is verified by specialists and regularly updated.
about.missionText: To give reliable, clear and timely answers to the most pressing questions of pet owners.
